method: Workflow/context assignments retain the prior source review. Direct general-operation labels are migrated provisionally; question-level decomposition is identified separately. Source instructions, review rationale and executable-framing proposals are preserved.
eligibility_policy: Include source tasks whose scientific purpose admits a clear executable framing, even when the original scorer is an LLM. Freeze missing conventions or scope narrative interpretation to computed evidence. Exclude a replacement objective, unavailable source instruction or unbounded subjective synthesis.
counting: Count each eligible record once per workflow, operation or context label. Operation annotation can be incomplete. Overlapping releases and shared protocols are not deduplicated; counts are requirements, not demonstrated competence.
